title: For each subject offered in the 'Engineering' school with total units great
question: For each subject offered in the 'Engineering' school with total units greater than 0 and only for subjects in the 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' department (Course 6), show the subject title, total units, department name, course description, and dense rank over the offer department code ordered by offer department code, along with the first name, last name, department name, student year, corresponding department's full name, administrative department name, and the average department phone number in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the administrative department name and ordered by the student's first name, for students whose department is '6' and whose department name is 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci', where the subject's offer department code matches the student's department. Then, for each offer department code, provide the maximum total units among these subjects and the count of distinct student years among the matched students. Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    c.SUBJECT_TITLE,
    c.TOTAL_UNITS,
    c.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    cd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION,
    c.DEPARTMENT_CODE AS OFFER_DEPT_CODE,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY c.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS DENSE_RANK_OFFER_DEPT,
    s.FIRST_NAME,
    s.LAST_NAME,
    s.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS STUDENT_DEPT_NAME,
    s.STUDENT_YEAR,
    sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME,
    ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    AVG(ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER) OVER (
      PARTITION BY ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME
      ORDER BY s.FIRST_NAME
      ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING
    ) AS AVG_DEPT_PHONE
  FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c
  JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd
    ON cd.COURSE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE
   AND cd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering'
  JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY s
    ON s.DEPARTMENT = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE
   AND s.DEPARTMENT = '6'
   AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci'
  JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd
    ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT
  JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad
    ON ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT
  WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci'
    AND c.TOTAL_UNITS > 0
)
SELECT
  OFFER_DEPT_CODE,
  MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) AS MAX_TOTAL_UNITS,
  COUNT(DISTINCT STUDENT_YEAR) AS DISTINCT_STUDENT_YEARS
FROM base
GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_CODE;

  MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units,
